body.description: Open an opportunity from the member's advisor page (the opportunities of his plan's markets: tender, project, order, RFQ) on the shared screen, with its details and contracting guide, when he asks to see one («افتحلي مناقصة الحديد في السعودية»). query = words from its title, entity or product; market / kind only narrow it. The call waits for the screen and returns what really opened (title, buyer, value, deadline as shown): say only that. If it returns that nothing matched, say so honestly and never claim it is open. Not for bassem_intel results (the first one already opens by itself on the screen, in the Information Center). For an item found with janna_lookup, bassem_open_item opens its own page with all its fields: prefer it.

rollback_body.description: Open an opportunity (tender, project, order, RFQ) for the member on the advisor page and show its details and how to contract. Use whenever you talk about a specific opportunity or the member asks to see one («افتحلي مناقصة الحديد في السعودية»). Pass the title/entity words; you can narrow by market.

query.description: Words from the opportunity title, entity or product

tools.source: holo5 anam/tools.json bassem_draft_email + MERGE-NOTES BROWSER §6 composer sentence

body.description: Write an e-mail for the member and put it ON THE SCREEN - it is NOT sent. For a deal (its deal room open, or `deal` = one of his deals) it fills that deal room; with no deal it opens in the e-mail composer on the shared screen, where he reviews, edits or copies it and sends it himself with its «ابعت» button (his own mail app). Subject and full body in `language`, signed with the member's title, name and company exactly as the platform gives them («بيانات العضو») or as he said them - the company keeps its own name in every language; products and sizes exactly as he said. Never read the body aloud, nor translate or summarise it aloud. Then one short sentence: deal room → «كتبتلك الإيميل وهو قدامك على الشاشة، تحب أبعته؟» and bassem_send_email only after his explicit OK; composer → tell him to review it and press ابعت himself (never call bassem_send_email for it, never say it was sent). For a Saudi/Gulf reader write language ar in formal Gulf-friendly Arabic; your own speech stays Egyptian.

to.description: ONLY an e-mail address that appears in the opportunity / deal data or that the member dictated himself; otherwise leave it out. Never invent one or use an example address (the screen offers a guessed address only, never fills it in).

body.description: Complete professional e-mail text in `language` (shown on screen, never spoken)

deal.description: Words identifying one of his deals; empty = the deal open on screen, or the composer when no deal room is open

language.description: The language the subject and body are actually written in: ar Arabic, en English, fr French, zh Chinese, es Spanish, de German, tr Turkish, ru Russian, pt Portuguese, it Italian

rollback_body.description: Write an email for the member inside the deal room (to the buyer, entity, supplier or partner) and fill it on screen: recipient, subject and full body in Arabic or English, signed with the member's name and company. It is NOT sent: read the key points to the member and ask for approval, then call bassem_send_email.

to.description: Recipient email if known from the opportunity (never invent one)

deal.description: Words identifying the deal/opportunity; empty = the deal open on screen
